title: Atlas · Tue Nov 17 · 2:30pm
big_picture: Taylor, the market fell again into Nvidia's report: S&P 500 down for a fourth day, the Dow down about 850 points, QQQ -0.7% and SPY -1.0% by EODHD's close ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/p-500-pullback-extends-fourth-211350265.html)). Nvidia reported after the close and the numbers were strong: revenue $115.8B against its own $108B guide and about $108.9B expected, non-GAAP EPS $2.68 against about $2.47, and a Q4 revenue guide of $130B (plus or minus 3%) against about $125B expected ([Nvidia release](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-announces-financial-results-third-212000678.html), [Investing.com preview](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-earnings-scenarios-numbers-guidance-210457990.html)). Early after-hours reports put the stock up roughly 2-4%, but sources differ and the real reaction is Wednesday's open ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/nvidia-quarterly-results-beat-estimates-5033943)). Two things in the report are not clean: the Q4 gross margin guide is 71-72% (Q3 was 74.8%), and receivables grew faster than sales again (below).

notes: - NVDA guide (t20261114-2): answered. Q4 revenue guide $130.0B plus or minus 3% (more than the $125B expected and my ~$109B line), no China data-centre compute assumed, but gross margin guide 71.0-72.0% against 74.8% in Q3. My earlier bull marker was margins at 74% or more, so it is half met: revenue yes, margin no ([Nvidia release](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-announces-financial-results-third-212000678.html)). Fact, from the company's own release.

- NVDA cash flow and receivables (t20261114-1): answered from the release. Free cash flow $43.8B against net income $65.3B (67%, up from 36% last quarter); that part recovered. But receivables are $81.0B against $63.1B last quarter, up 28% while revenue rose 20%, and inventory is $39.7B. Net cash from operations includes an $18.1B receivables build. The company bought $15.7B of equity securities in the quarter and its non-marketable securities are $65.5B (from $22.3B in January); who it invested in is not in the release. I read the release only, not the CFO commentary or the call ([same release](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-announces-financial-results-third-212000678.html)).
- Copper miners (t20261117-2): answered above, price fall on demand fears, not company news.

Trend board changes: AI build-out moves from "watching" to "fading", and this is a judgement call you may want to overrule. One kill line has happened on the numbers: "NVDA receivables keep climbing faster than sales" (receivables +28% against revenue +20%, up from $63.1B to $81.0B). Against that, revenue, the Q4 guide and cash flow were strong, no other kill hit (MU 712 is above $650; SMH is above its low), and the Anthropic pricing and tomorrow's market reaction are still ahead. I did not close it, because the main kill line is intact and the call is not yet read. Added evidence: the release numbers, the Q4 margin guide, and today's closes.

Your lessons: none tested yet. L6 (NVDA report, perception over numbers) is the live one: the numbers beat and the guide is above expectations; its test needs the next-day and one-week moves of NVDA, SMH and MU, so it waits for Wednesday's close and later. L1 and L2 stay waiting too.
